replan_note: Previous experiments covered redis-cart, frontend, productcatalogservice, and currencyservice. Remaining untested single‑replica services are cartservice, paymentservice, shippingservice, and checkoutservice. The plan selects cartservice (pod_failure) and paymentservice (pod_kill) to test distinct failure modes (availability vs restart) and measure customer impact via error_rate and p95_ms. These faults are not yet used on their targets and target the highest risk services with the largest blast radius. The criteria are set above baseline to capture meaningful customer impact. No integrity checks are needed as these services are stateless. The plan respects the fault limits and duration constraints. The experiments will be run sequentially with safety ramping handled by the system.
